releases.name: Courier of the Dead
releases.summary:
Courier of the Dead is an atmospheric horror experience set in an abandoned village where the the dead are disturbed after sunset.

Each night, the courier must deliver letters meant for restless spirits scattered throughout the village. The messages left behind contain clues about where their recipients lie, forcing players to read carefully and navigate the dark streets to discover the correct resting places.

To survive the night, players must interpret clues to locate delivery items, as well as collectible items, and complete deliveries before the night ends.

releases.name: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
releases.summary: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

releases.name: Terra Machina
releases.summary: Dig deep, build big, and let science do the smashing! TerraMachina is a 2D mining and factory sandbox. Turn mountains of ore into powerful drills, weapons, and automated factories across diverse biomes. Play solo or in co-op for up to 4 players.

releases.name: Reverie: Audio Stories
releases.summary: Illustrated audio stories where you decide what happens next. Listen on headphones or speakers, choose left or right, and enjoy them even with your eyes closed. First story free: The Messenger of Corbeval, 40 minutes and 7 endings.

releases.name: Gross Survivors
releases.summary: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

releases.name: Victoria 3: State and Revolution
releases.summary: BIN90 HD will let you have a wonderful time, while challenging your attention and luck. If you have never won a lottery in real life, why not give it a try and become a champion online? Each player will receive 3 cards with a 9x3 table on each and numbers ranging from 1 through 90 randomly placed in each cell (5 in each row). This is when the fun begins – the program takes barrels with random numbers out of a virtual bag. As the bag empties, the cells on the players’ cards fill in. In each round of BIN90 HD there are several winners – the bronze medal (and 15% of the jackpot) goes to the player who first fills one row on any card, the silver medal and 25% of the jackpot go to the player who fills 2 rows, and the honorary first place and half the jackpot go to the player who fills all the rows on any card. In addition, there are bonuses which make it easier to fill out the game cards: · automatic filling of the next barrel; ·  automatic display of the next five barrels; ·  filling-in of the missed barrel (after it disappears from the top panel); ·  convenient cell lighting corresponding to the barrel pulled. See you at the game table!

releases.name: Orbital Madness
releases.summary: Orbital Madness is an incremental action roguelite where everything revolves around orbitals. Build an arsenal of spinning weapons, create ridiculous chaos, defeat hordes of enemies and grow stronger between every run.

releases.name: Gaelco Sports Collection
releases.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate 90s arcade rush. This collection brings back 5 legendary, lightning-fast hits developed by the arcade masters at Gaelco. Forget complex simulations; here, it’s all about raw reflexes, immediate fun, and high-speed challenges that defined a generation of cabinet gaming.

Drive at breakneck speeds in the cult-classic isometric racers World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, where every corner requires perfect drifts against a brutal 60-second timer.

Conquer treacherous slopes in Snowboard Championship, execute precise racket strikes in Squash, and dominate the sand with fierce smashes in Touch and Go.

It’s a pure dopamine rush straight from the golden age of arcades.

releases.name: UNCOUNTED
releases.summary: Uncounted is a massive incremental tower defense. One sector, one wave: tens of thousands of hostiles simulated on the GPU. Place and aim every turret before the drop, then spend the run to unlock the next gun.

releases.name: The Grave Abyss
releases.summary: Grab your sword and descend to the deepest depths of a corrupted cave to find and destroy the source of evil that plagues the small town of Oakhaven. The Grave Abyss is an old school single player, 3d dungeon crawler RPG with turn based combat.

releases.name: Zombie Last Stand
releases.summary: Take your last stand against an evolving zombie swarm. Fight ten enemy types and two deadly bosses, collect special bullets, armor and permanent upgrades, survive extreme weather events, unlock SWAT skins, complete achievements, and chase a higher score with every run.

releases.name: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia
releases.summary: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia is a third-person mafia-themed fighting game where you must assemble your own gang and defeat all your enemies.

releases.name: Dealer's Choice
releases.summary: Three roguelites at one table. Drop balls through a plinko board, roll dice for poker hands, bet against a roulette wheel you rebuild as you play — then push your luck for one more floor, one more roll, one more spin. The Dealer is watching.
